rights.access: Right of access: request a copy of your data.
rights.rectification: Right to rectification: correct inaccurate information.

legal.sales_intro: This sales policy details pricing, payment, cancellation, and refund terms for services offered on BoostYourLife.
legal.sales_pricing_li1: Program and subscription prices are shown in euros (€), all taxes included (VAT).
legal.sales_pricing_li2: Payment is made online by bank card or any method offered.
legal.sales_pricing_li3: Billing occurs immediately upon order confirmation.
legal.sales_withdrawal_p1: Under French law (Art. L221-18), you have 14 calendar days to withdraw without justification or penalty.
legal.sales_withdrawal_p2: For digital content delivered immediately after payment, you waive the right of withdrawal once you expressly agree to start the service and acknowledge waiving this right (Art. L221-28). If you started using the service, you can no longer withdraw.
legal.sales_withdrawal_p3: To exercise your right within the deadline, send a clear statement before it expires (email to support@boostyourlife.coach or via the contact form). Registered mail is not required but can provide additional proof.
legal.sales_delivery_p1: Services are available online immediately after payment is confirmed. You will receive a confirmation email with instructions to start your program.
legal.sales_support_p1: For any billing or service questions, contact support@boostyourlife.coach. We reply within 48 hours.

about.title: About
about.intro: Welcome to Boost Your Life! Our mission is to make training effective, clear and motivating so you progress every week — without getting lost in complicated plans.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.body: We build personalised programs that adapt to your level, time and goals (fat loss, muscle gain, performance, getting back in shape). Everything is designed to be simple to follow and sustainable.

features.title: What you get
items: A personalised program that auto-adjusts from your feedback (RPE, load, notes)
Step-by-step workouts with cues, alternatives and tempos
Clear stats: progress per movement and per workout
Exercises adapted to your equipment (gym, home, minimal)
Reminders and calendar — stay consistent without thinking about it
Access to premium programs and coach support if needed

autonomy.title: Your autonomy
autonomy.body: You stay in control: move a session, shorten one, add notes or request a variant. The app guides you without overload — every session counts toward your goals.

why.title: Why it works
items: Planned progression: load & difficulty adjust automatically
Execution clarity: know exactly what to do and when to rest
Context-aware: gym, home or minimal equipment
Trackable progress: simple tables per session and movement

vision.title: Our vision
vision.body:
We believe modern coaching should rely on modern tools.

Our ambition is to become a benchmark for independent coaches who want to structure, professionalize, and grow their business.

Coaching no longer relies only on technical expertise, but also on the ability to deliver a clear, measurable, and consistent experience.

Boost Your Life is part of this evolution.

The platform continuously evolves to adapt to coaches' needs and to the realities of the field.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions

q1.q: Is it easy to set up and adapt to my coaching method?
q1.a: Yes. You can start simple (one session, one client) and structure progressively. The tool adapts to your coaching style: you keep your parameters, your organization and habits — with a clearer, more professional framework.

q2.q: Is it really useful for clients?
q2.a: Yes, because clients don’t need to understand your back-office: they follow a guided session that’s clear and structured. Result: fewer mistakes, more consistency, and progress that’s easier to visualize.

q3.q: Is it compatible with remote coaching, at-home, and in-gym coaching?
q3.a: Yes. You can coach in person, on video, or let clients train independently. In all cases, the calendar, history, and progress remain centralized.

q4.a: You’ll have time to test the tool with your real routine. The trial is no-card: you choose what’s next only if you see real value (time saved, clarity, pro output).

q5.q: How does it help me look more professional?
q5.a: Your programs become clearer and better structured, and your tracking becomes easier to follow. Less improvisation, more control — that’s what clients feel, and what boosts your credibility.

q6.q: Can I track more than just sessions (measurements, data…)?
q6.a: Yes. You can also centralize body metrics like weight, measurements, and other indicators to complement session tracking and visualize progress over time.
